game_title: Trace Table Race – Festival Grounds Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round, siege rats strike the throne, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the throne from siege rats in Festival Grounds: keep the trace_rows_correct meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: trace_rows_correct drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while trace_rows_correct > 0.
